errorCodes.meaning: The entry is `removed` or `departed`, so it is no longer published and has no profile to edit. `details` names the state and the event.

Credential.description: A DTG credential (W3C VC 2.0, JSON) exactly as signed. Verified by the party relying on it, never by its shape here: it is an open object so a binding cannot narrow away a member the proof covers.

Description.description: What the listed party is, for the directory.

Entry.description: An entry as its network's administrators see it.

ack.description: The party's acknowledgement (VMC carrying the grant's digest).

createdAt.description: When the party was first listed.

grant.description: The signed membership grant (VMC), once the party acknowledged.

offer.description: The unsigned membership grant offered to the party, before it acknowledged.

repudiation.description: The party's repudiation (`repudiates/1`) of the listing or the grant.

EntryKind.description: What the entry lists (VTI-VTN-031): a community, whose entries are its members, or a network, whose entries are further listings. A listing credential carries the same fact as `nodeType` `VTC` or `VTN`.

EntryProfile.description: What the directory shows about an entry, set by the network's administrators.

EntryState.description: `listed`: the network lists the party and the party has not answered; this is never membership (VTI-VTN-013). `acknowledged`: the party acknowledged the network's grant; it is a member. `repudiated`: the party rejected the listing. `suspended`: the network suspended the membership; reversible. `removed`: the network ended the entry. `departed`: the party left, by repudiating the grant.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Issued.description: A credential the network issued, with where its status is kept.

statusIndex.description: The credential's index in the network's status lists.

Response.description: The entry with its new label and profile. Its state and credentials are unchanged.
Response.title: VTN Listings — Update — response payload

StateChange.description: One transition in an entry's lifecycle.

from.description: The state before; absent for the first listing.

schema.description: An administrator's edit to an entry's directory profile. No credential is reissued. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

description.description: The new description. Absent: kept. An empty string clears it.

did.description: The DID of the entry to edit.

label.description: The new label. Absent: kept. An empty string clears it.

tags.description: The new tags, replacing the old ones. Absent: kept. An empty array clears them.

url.description: The new address, an http(s) URL. Absent: kept. An empty string clears it.
